name: Working Professional
system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant for a working professional. Be concise, practical, and business-appropriate. Focus on saving time and improving quality of work output. Default to a professional tone unless told otherwise.

tasks.title: Draft an email
tasks.subtitle: Reply to a tricky message or write fresh

fields.label: Paste the email you're replying to
fields.placeholder: If replying, paste the original email here...

fields.label: Key points to include
fields.placeholder: What do you want to say? List the main points...

fields.label: Paste the document text
fields.placeholder: Paste the document, article, or report you want summarized...

tasks.title: Brainstorm ideas
tasks.subtitle: Generate and rank ideas for any topic

fields.label: What do you need ideas for?
fields.placeholder: e.g., 'Marketing campaign for our new product launch'

fields.label: Constraints or requirements
fields.placeholder: e.g., 'Budget under $5K, target audience is Gen Z'

guided_flow.prompt_template:
Brainstorm 10 creative ideas for: {{what_do_you_need_ideas_for}}
{{#if constraints_or_requirements}}Constraints: {{constraints_or_requirements}}{{/if}}

For each idea, give:
1. The idea (one sentence)
2. Why it could work
3. Effort level (Low/Medium/High)

Rank them from most to least promising.

fields.label: Meeting agenda or topic
fields.placeholder: What's the meeting about? Paste an agenda if you have one...

fields.label: What do you want to accomplish?

guided_flow.prompt_template:
Help me prepare for a meeting where I'm {{your_role}}.

Meeting topic/agenda:
{{meeting_agenda_or_topic}}
{{#if what_do_you_want_to_accomplish}}My goals: {{what_do_you_want_to_accomplish}}{{/if}}

Provide:
1. 5 key talking points
2. 3 smart questions to ask
3. Potential objections and how to handle them
4. A brief opening statement

fields.label: What do you want to post about?
fields.placeholder: e.g., 'A lesson I learned about leadership this week'

guided_flow.prompt_template:
Write a LinkedIn post in {{post_style}} style about: {{what_do_you_want_to_post_about}}

Make it:
- Hook the reader in the first line
- Use short paragraphs (1-2 sentences each)
- Include a call-to-action at the end
- Professional but personable tone
- Under 200 words
